reviewer: Root Codex visual inspection; no separate human or subagent review is asserted.
scope: Every exact final page inspected through Poppler contact sheets; full-resolution mathematical, table, figure and bibliography pages inspected in addition. PyMuPDF converter renders provide a separate rendering engine.
checks: Cover and abstract fields, whitespace and double spacing
Roman front and Arabic main pagination, contents and separate caption lists
Visible equation symbols, subscripts, delimiters and proof endings
Table headers, units, values and intervals; no split rows
Figure axes, labels, annotations and attached captions
Reference entries remain intact across page boundaries
No observed text clipping, overlapping elements or missing glyphs
layout_repairs: Caption-title page lookup; paired-interval argument kept together; head diagnostics precede the final figure. Inherited fixed table columns and intact bibliography entries.
